mapper.insert: INSERT INTO syndromes (id, syndrome_code, syndrome_name, syndrome_name_pinyin, syndrome_name_pinyin_abbr, description, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{syndromeCode}, #{syndromeName}, #{syndromeNamePinyin}, #{syndromeNamePinyinAbbr}, #{description}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE syndromes SET syndrome_code = #{syndromeCode}, syndrome_name = #{syndromeName}, syndrome_name_pinyin = #{syndromeNamePinyin}, syndrome_name_pinyin_abbr = #{syndromeNamePinyinAbbr}, description = #{description}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, syndrome_code as syndromeCode, syndrome_name as syndromeName, syndrome_name_pinyin as syndromeNamePinyin, syndrome_name_pinyin_abbr as syndromeNamePinyinAbbr, description, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, deleted_at as deletedAt FROM syndromes WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0

SELECT id, syndrome_code as syndromeCode, syndrome_name as syndromeName, syndrome_name_pinyin as syndromeNamePinyin, syndrome_name_pinyin_abbr as syndromeNamePinyinAbbr, description, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, deleted_at as deletedAt FROM syndromes WHERE deleted_at = 0
